license_required.quote: Any person practicing or offering to practice as: (1)A registered nurse; (2)A licensed practical nurse; or (3)An advanced practice registered nurse in this state shall be required to submit evidence to the Board of Nursing that she is qualified to so practice, shall be licensed, and shall use the appropriate licensure title.
